item.title: Oregon Industries Could Face Uneven Strain as U.S.-Born Workforce Shrinks and Immigrant Workforce Grows
item.description: With January employment data indicating that the nationwide US-born workforce is shrinking while the foreign-born workforce grows, Oregon’s labor market, with a larger-than-average share of migratory workers concentrated in sectors like manufacturing and agriculture, could mean that national swings in immigrant employment will hit Oregon industries unevenly. item.title: Beaverton Debates City Code Change That Would Allow Officers to Investigate Misconduct by ICE Agents
item.description: BEAVERTON, Ore. — Mounting public pressure to investigate alleged acts of violence and reckless driving by federal immigration agents is being considered by the Beaverton City Council.
